C9000259.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 259 (A group without fixed price.; papers: A group without fixed price; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_PLANAR_RESOLUTION.statement: Resolve the complete coefficient-sensitive statement planar:main, not only its exterior-letter projection.

C_PLANAR.statement: Lemma planar:main: for m(r)>=7, a cyclically H-reduced null word has a full cyclic coefficient-preserving match or two exterior-disjoint coefficient-preserving matches of lengths at least m(r)-3.

C_PLANAR_STRONG.statement: Under the same coefficient-group injectivity, positivity, uniqueness and overlap hypotheses, m(r)>=4 suffices and the two matching intervals have at least m(r)-2 exterior occurrences.

C_PLANAR_UNCONDITIONAL.statement: For arbitrary H and exterior alphabet, the relator hypotheses with m>=4 imply coefficient-group injectivity and the full matching dichotomy with loss two, without assuming injectivity.

C_PLANAR_EMBEDDING.statement: Positive relators with no repeated exterior generator, pairwise exterior-generator overlap at most one, and m>=4 preserve an arbitrary coefficient group in the quotient.

C_PLANAR_BRIDGE.statement: For a cyclically H-reduced null word W with an exterior occurrence and m>=4, a least-relator filling over arbitrary H yields a connected sphere band graph with simple bipartite inner graph, the prescribed inner degrees, no monogons, and exact coefficient face equations, without assuming coefficient-group injectivity.

C_PLANAR_FILLING.statement: Finite normal-form fillings over arbitrary H give constant exterior tracks. Minimality removes same-relator dipoles; positivity, uniqueness and pairwise overlap imply the inner graph is simple bipartite with prescribed degrees. Neither connectedness nor injectivity is assumed in this construction.

C_PLANAR_FINITE.statement: For a finite connected sphere band graph with a distinguished outside vertex, no monogon faces and a simple bipartite inner graph of minimum degree four, the corner-and-cyclic-gap argument gives a full bigon cycle or two distinct inner vertices with consecutive bigon strings using all but at most two incidences and disjoint outside endpoints.

C_PLANAR_KERNEL.statement: The normalized finite band argument proves the closed-component obstruction and, with exact group-valued bigon equations, injective incidence maps, degree at least four, corner partition, face bounds and sphere Euler equation, a full bigon cycle or two ordered coefficient-equal disjoint intervals missing at most two relator occurrences.

C_PLANAR_SHARP.statement: The strengthened bound m(r)-2 is optimal for each common length m>=4; permitting lengths three and four invalidates the dichotomy, and permitting length three invalidates automatic coefficient-group injectivity.

C_PLANAR_MATCH.statement: Constant exterior bands and complementary-region equations give equality of every intervening H coefficient, not conjugacy; intervals at distinct inner vertices use disjoint outer occurrences.

C_PLANAR_REFUTATION.statement: There exists a counterexample to planar:main satisfying every stated hypothesis, including injectivity of H into D.

C_RANK_MAIN.statement: rank:main: n positive length-100 rows with expansion |N(T)|>96|T| for 1<=|T|<=alpha*n, 100*b<=alpha*n and alpha*n>=1 present a group of rank greater than alpha*n/100.

C_RANK_SURGERY.statement: The saturation and marked-graph shortening steps needed after planar:main establish rank:main.

C_MODELS_TRANSFER.statement: models:transfer: relative J-to-A cost in the Bernoulli action is at least limsup rank(D_Vk)/|Vk| for asymptotically free finite exact right A-models.

C_MODELS_SEQUENCE.statement: models:sequence: the required asymptotically free permutation models exist with small-set expansion greater than 96 and o(n) bad rows.

C_COMPRESSION_MAIN.statement: compression:main: deployment/compression bounds the Bernoulli Gamma-cost below by one plus the relative J-to-A cost.

C_BERNOULLI_LOWER.statement: The Bernoulli action in intro:main has cost at least 1+alpha/100.

C_ACTIONS_LOW.statement: actions:low: the finite-height action Y_M has cost at most 1+99/M for M>100.

C_MAIN.statement: intro:main: the displayed rank-100 amalgam has Bernoulli cost at least 1+alpha/100 and finite-height cost at most 1+99/M, hence does not have fixed price.
